description: The Bogota study forecasts storage in four reservoirs using SARIMA for unimodal Chuza and Fourier-ARIMA for northern bimodal reservoirs. CSV and R files support the comparison motivated by the 2024 water crisis. This resource is provided by Paula Bogotá; Antonio Preziosi-Ribero; Nicolas Ariza Mora. Coverage is regional as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists CSV, R formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: MIT. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: Reported error differences compare different reservoir contexts and do not isolate the modelling method alone. For simulation, it documents an application that can inform scenario design. Related catalogue record: model-hec-ras. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
